purpose: Review owned single-claim final calibration, retained calculation source, count-event semantics, final-result access isolation, immutable request aliases and bounded summary serialization.

scope.execution: Disposable SQLite registries; synthetic trusted protected artifacts; real authenticated wrapper, worker, reporter and release RPCs; pure request-alias and full-envelope checks.
scope.review_only: Runner identity, source/current-version checks, orphan-recovery call path, seed checks, owned event extraction, scope and target labels were inspected. The reviewer did not independently execute the expensive full retained development/final simulation fixture or full regression.

findings.finding: The existing generic release mechanism could otherwise admit a released work product without inspecting protected ancestor classes. The new transitive schema guard denies both discovery and formalizer context admission through source_refs or exposure before availability/content/blob access.
findings.cases: Direct final input/attempt; add_source development relabeling; add_research sources and depends_on; three source-ref-only layers; real completed/released reporter work products and typed research records; a further source summary of the released output. Ordinary released development reports remain usable.

findings.problem: Python dictionary equality treated max_attempts=True as the frozen integer 1 and seed=False as the frozen integer 0. These invalid changed requests were accepted as aliases without fresh schema validation.
findings.scope_of_impact: An exact request-integrity failure; the old retained budget and seeds were not reset by these particular values.
findings.red_evidence: The 10-test suite produced exactly two failing subtests for the two Boolean substitutions on source SHA256 89464d02bef54b3540dd092e240e004e9d15548dbb475f3ad2190f2485141059.
findings.fix: The parent changed fixed-field comparison to canonical digests. Both unchanged regression cases now reject; changing only the already matched lookup IDs remains allowed.

findings.problem: A final inventory could fit the world/cohort limits while the completed unavailable-event request exceeded the codec 1 MiB envelope. Two directional stress specifications produced 1,157,786 bytes, although the all-verified representation was 991,898 bytes.
findings.fix: Preparation now constructs the full worst-case unavailable representation with all cohort/world entries, the actual applicability declaration, the fixed reason and 64-character owned source identities. Canonical size validation occurs before source capture and child execution.
findings.qualification: The pure preparation helper was exercised independently; the owned call site was inspected. Every manifest remained unchanged, including all 1536 worlds in the rejected case. No scientific cells were trimmed.

scientific_and_operational_review.events: Replay-checked VERIFIED outcomes map support at zero, support-or-negative at the boundary, detection at twice delta, and not-covered per scenario. INFORMATION_GAP is a known no-decision only for decision criteria; its interval coverage remains unavailable. Technical and model failures remain unavailable.
scientific_and_operational_review.family_scope: The implemented primary_count=1 is a degenerate joint family; mixed-true-effect multi-claim calibration stays UNAVAILABLE. It does not complete the general mixed-family requirement.
scientific_and_operational_review.target: The target must occur in the completed development grid. A match to the selected development candidate is labeled separately from a studied sensitivity cutoff; n_min and scientific readiness remain unset/false.
scientific_and_operational_review.identity: Final identity binds retained case/model/scientific settings and original calculation source. Known provenance aliases, rationale/order differences and reset controls are excluded from that identity; the retained request separately freezes seed, budget, cost and applicability. This is not a general proof of semantic equivalence between different programs.
scientific_and_operational_review.freshness: The final namespace and complete fixed inventory precede execution; both PRNG streams and world IDs are checked against recorded development/final inventories. Recorded seed disjointness is not proof of mathematical independence or population adequacy.
scientific_and_operational_review.source: The original retained development calculator source is loaded for fresh generation/replay children. The host assessment source is separately pinned. Drift blocks new execution and yields NOT_ASSESSED count interpretation while the operational recovery path remains available.
scientific_and_operational_review.accounting: The existing reservation, settlement, retained failure, same-world retry and orphan fencing lifecycle is reused. All attempts remain in artifact/event history. Unknown orphan usage retains a full reservation and does not authorize blind replacement execution.
scientific_and_operational_review.authentication_scope: Owned attempt and event checks improve input provenance. They do not establish correct market models, sufficient stress applicability, independent semantics, scientific certification or capital authority.

initial_access_fixture_run.cause: Reviewer fixture omitted required created_at on trusted final artifacts and did not seal the explicit reporter batch before claim. Only fixture prerequisites were corrected; access expectations remained unchanged.

verification.envelope_reproduction: Six before-fix representations were measured; the helper was then exercised on all three supported-size examples after the fix. Both scripts exited 0 with explicit expected rejection recorded, not silently ignored.
verification.parent_reported_not_independently_rerun: Before the final two fixes, 3 actual owned integration tests passed in 132.440 seconds, including retained development 3 worlds and final 1 world with separate generation/replay. Parent follow-up calibration and study regression processes were still running when this review was written; no final result is inferred.

warranted_conclusion: The final source passes the independently exercised access and alias checks and rejects the reproduced oversized final-count envelope before execution. The reviewed single-claim event mapping and source boundaries preserve the stated qualifications. This is bounded engineering evidence, not a completed 256-world scientific calibration or general calibration certificate.
not_verified: No complete 256-world-per-scenario final simulation run was independently executed by this reviewer.
No multi-claim mixed-truth population construction, heavy-tail return law, market-model adequacy or actual stress-applicability evidence.
No mathematical PRNG independence, unseen-model-data claim, full-process calibration, information-target admission or capital authority.
Source-drift reasoning covers the implemented guard/recovery path; arbitrary future schema migration is not certified.
No full repository regression or independent replay of the parent expensive integration run.
next_action: Preserve the reviewed source and report the parent focused regression outcomes separately. A final assessment may proceed only within its frozen complete inventory and resource envelope; all missing/failed worlds and conditional applicability remain visible.
